comment: Shift 1-2 Layout: 13x9 cells of 1 m, camera looking north from the open south edge. See .scratch/signal-room/issues/07-room-layout-movement.md.

entities.name: NorthWall
entities.comment: Full height: the camera looks north at it.

entities.name: WestWall
entities.comment: Low, so nothing hides the floor.

entities.name: SouthEdge
entities.comment: The open south edge: collides, no mesh. The desk edge dresses it.

entities.name: Radio1
entities.comment: Three Radios on the north wall at (1-2,0), (4-5,0) and (8-9,0); Shift 1 puts only Radio1 in service.

entities.name: Radio3
entities.comment: The storm-window cells (6-7,0) stay walkable: a gap between Radio2 and Radio3.

entities.name: Keypunch
entities.comment: Tarped unless a Shift (or the keypunch Modifier) puts it in service.

entities.name: Decoder
entities.comment: On the rug, worked from all four sides.

entities.name: CounterOilCan
entities.comment: Replaces the out-of-scope Cooling Vent. Plain in Shift 1; Shift 2 starts the Oil Can here, ~7 m from the Decoder.

entities.name: CipherRotorsTarp
entities.comment: Dressing tarp over the Cipher Rotors (out of scope), no Station data.

entities.name: SupplyRackTarp
entities.comment: Dressing tarp over the Supply Rack in the NE corner.

entities.name: PowerPanelTarp
entities.comment: Dressing tarp over the Power Panel on the west wall beside rows 3-4; no floor footprint.

entities.name: StormWindow
entities.comment: On the north wall above cells (6-7,0).

entities.name: DeskEdge
entities.comment: Foreground desk along the open south edge, fitted to the south row; not solid (SouthEdge collides).
